_comment: Gemini API paid-tier (Standard) prices in USD per 1M tokens, copied from
2026-10-22, retrieved 2026-10-23). Prices change: check the page and
edit this file, or pass your own file with --pricing_file.
Batch/Flex/Priority tiers, free-tier usage, context-cache storage and
grounding fees are not modelled. Each model has a list of price periods
(inclusive 'from'/'until' dates, UTC); the period containing the date of
the API call is used. Keys:
input: input tokens (text/image/video, and audio unless
input_audio: input audio tokens, for models that price audio separately
cached_input / cached_input_audio: implicitly or explicitly cached
output: output tokens, including thinking tokens (audio for TTS models)
Models missing from this file get token counts but no cost
